spans.text: **No new facts.** Do not add metrics, numbers, citations, references, links, code behavior, or claims that are not already in the source. If a claim is flagged as unsupported (RULE-H), leave it flagged — do not invent support.
spans.note: The prompt strongly enforces truthfulness and information integrity through its 'No new facts' hard invariant, explicitly prohibiting the fabrication of metrics, numbers, citations, references, links, or claims not already in the source. It also instructs the model to leave unsupported claims flagged rather than inventing support.
